text.p: The following are leading domestic stories in Portuguese newspapers.

-The government is going to increase working hours for pilots at troubled state airline TAP. It is also considering allowing TAP to contract foreign pilots to replace the company's own pilots who are refusing to work overtime.

-Portuguese entrepreneur Jose Sousa Cintra is buying mineral water company Aguas do Alardo from Belgium's Spadel for a symbolic price of one escudo. Sousa Cintra will invest 1.5 billion escudos in Alardo which was on the point of filing for bankruptcy.

-French television company Telediffusion de France is taking legal action against independent Portuguese television channel TVI because it has been unable to exercise its right to sell its stake in TVI's transmission unit RETI.
